changes: Released 2026-11-26 (XC_VM-GO, unofficial fork based on XC_VM 2.7.4).

ClearKey DASH engine (ckts) sized to the server at start: memory limit = 10 % of RAM (4 to 32 GiB) instead of a fixed 8 GiB, and at most a third of the cores (4 to 32). A busy server no longer hits the old limit, which made ckts clean memory non-stop and fall behind on every DASH channel at once.
Override in the ckts unit with CKTS_MEMLIMIT (e.g. 12GiB) and CKTS_MAXPROCS (e.g. 16).
Updating restarts ckts once (DASH channels restart).
Includes everything from 2.7.4-p4: CPU fix for Go live channels, Go default for live and on-demand channels.
